specification:
DASH reference-client video-on-demand workload (stand-in for Prudentia's VoD category using the public dash.js reference player — no account needed).
1. Open the DASH-IF reference player with manifest <secret>mpd_url</secret> and autoLoad enabled (reference stream: Big Buck Bunny on Akamai).
2. Wait briefly for the player to load and playback to start.
3. Keep the video playing for <secret>watch_seconds</secret> seconds.
